checks.task_description: SEO Specialist audits redirect chains on crawler-test.com using Screaming Frog's Response Codes tab, exports 3xx redirect data CSV, and writes a written redirect audit report
deliverables: Response Codes CSV filtered to 3xx redirects (with Status Code and Redirect URL columns)
Written report ~/Documents/SEO/reports/redirect_report.txt documenting redirect counts, types (301/302), and recommendations

scoring_breakdown.csv_structure: 25 pts — CSV has Status Code column, Redirect URL column, 3xx data present
scoring_breakdown.domain_and_rows: 20 pts — crawler-test.com URLs confirmed, ≥3 redirect rows
scoring_breakdown.report: 25 pts — redirect_report.txt exists, ≥200 bytes, contains counts and redirect type mentions

checks.score_cap_gate: If report_exists=False and score>50, score is capped at 50 — both deliverables are required
checks.anti_gaming: TASK_START_EPOCH prevents stale exports; domain check prevents wrong-site; report size check prevents empty files
